title: Into Yomi
notes: Takamagahara (Region 3) is on hold and shows COMING SOON again. Focus is fully on Yomi.
Yomi Arena now follows the Circles: every circle boss you defeat opens the next fighter (like the rank arenas in Neo-Tokyo). Fighters are a bit stronger than their circle, a real exam.
Yomi has its own creatures: Gaki, Yurei, Kasha, Hell Oni, Gashadokuro, Tsuchigumo, Shinigami ... and a named lord in every circle, up to Izanami, Queen of the Dead.
Every Yomi Arena fighter has their own line.
New look for brutes, oni and wardens: a hunched bone giant, a horned oni with a kanabo club, an armored samurai lord with a naginata.
Daily Gates reminder only shows in Neo-Tokyo.
